rateLimits.note: "There is a rate limit of 4 requests per second", answered by 429 beyond it; and "up to 8 open requests at any moment in time" (concurrency). Twitch's application token, asked of id.twitch.tv, is one request more when it is renewed.

provenance.notes: IGDB is free for non-commercial use under the Twitch Developer Services Agreement; its FAQ says the API is free for commercial projects too, but monetized products go through its commercial partnership (partner@igdb.com), and the Agreement forbids selling, licensing or monetizing Twitch Data without Twitch's written permission: commercial use is declared under contract. Storage and caching: IGDB's FAQ "we prefer if you store and serve the data to your end users" (read as IGDB's written authorization; the Agreement otherwise allows a 24-hour cache only). Re-syndication and redistribution of the data as the API gives it are prohibited (the Agreement). Attribution visible to the users, in a static place (not a changelog), to IGDB.com. Twitch client credentials (client id and secret) give the application token; never in a browser.
